system.description:
You violently whip your weapon with enough force to crack the ground from the impact. Select a point you can see within your weapons range. Creatures in a 5-foot radius of the chosen point must make a Dexterity saving throw as they are struck. On a failed save, the target takes your weapons damage + 1d10 or half as much on a successful save.

Chain 1: A creature who failed their save also gains a rank of Bleeding.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
